goal: Avoid lock contention between secondary indexes and block validation
Prevent startup race conditions and stale index query results during chain reorganizations
Enable secondary indexes to eventually run out-of-process
agreement: Broad concept and approach support across multiple iterations (sedited, mzumsande, fjahr, josibake)
Answered objection on ignoring reverse-block return values remains unconfirmed (furszy)
Multiple earlier startup race conditions and crash reports were tested and resolved (mzumsande, furszy)

categories.name: indexes
why: P2 because removing validation locks during index sync reduces lock contention with block validation
Resolves startup race conditions under reindex and stops queries from returning stale data during reorgs
